observations.says: from ten o'clock on Friday night, the cellar door was locked; at six o'clock on Saturday morning, the cellar door was open: between the two, somebody unlocked and opened the cellar door, which needs a key of the cellar door and being at the cellar door
nobody but Martha Coyle and Jem Tully had a key of the cellar door
from ten o'clock on Friday night until six o'clock on Saturday morning, Jem Tully had the second key of the cellar door
from ten o'clock on Friday night until six o'clock on Saturday morning, Ned Sharp was in the loft over the stable
from ten o'clock on Friday night until six o'clock on Saturday morning, Jem Tully was in the passage behind the taproom
at six o'clock on Saturday morning, Ned Sharp was drunk
